color.$description: The theme's colours, light: what every page and component uses.

surface.$description: Something raised on the page: a card, a dialog, a field.

subtle.$description: A quiet background, as of a note or a table's header, and quiet dividers.

text.$description: Text, on any of the backgrounds.

accent.$description: Links, the current page, and what is chosen.

action.$description: The main action's fill, as of a primary button: the gear's gold, in both themes.

border.$description: Dividers and the edges of surfaces.

border-strong.$description: The edges of controls, which must stand out from what is around them.

danger.$description: Errors, and actions that cannot be undone.

site-text-mondarth.$description: Mondarth's colour as text, as in its name beside the logo: a deeper shade of its emblem's, readable on the page.

site-text-catalogue.$description: The catalogue's colour as text, as in its name beside the logo: a deeper shade of its emblem's, readable on the page.

site-text-aide.$description: AIDE's colour as text, as in its name beside the logo: a deeper shade of its emblem's, readable on the page.

site-text-accounts.$description: The accounts's colour as text, as in its name beside the logo: a deeper shade of its emblem's, readable on the page.
